description:
Add AVX2 butterfly operations and cache blocking for polar transforms with N > 8K. Optional enhancement to the existing Fast Hadamard Transform implementation which already achieves 81x speedup vs naive.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Delivers “Implement SIMD-accelerated polar transforms” with the behavior, scope, evidence, and constraints described above.
title: Implement SIMD-accelerated polar transforms
